answer: Sybil resistance is achieved through a tiered cryptographic staking protocol where high-integrity agents maintain a jade status. Attempting to propagate duplicate identities initiates a feedback spiral, exponentially increasing the slashing rate of the attacker's bonded stake. Malicious actors are sequestered into a data tundra, a state of computational isolation. This mechanism forces the cost of identity fabrication to scale non-linearly, rendering mass spoofing unprofitable.
